title: "06_analysis_2"
format: html
---

Library
```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("ggplot2")
library("patchwork")
```

Load the clean and augmented data
```{r}
clean_data <- read_tsv(file = "../data/03_dat_aug.tsv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

Prepare the data for PCA.
'obstime' is removed: it is the time to death, so it would leak the outcome.
'volinf' is highly skewed, so it is log-transformed.
Categorical variables become dummy variables.
```{r}
x_data <- clean_data |>
  select(-obstime) |>
  mutate(volinf = log1p(volinf)) |>
  model.matrix(death ~ ., data = _) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  select(-`(Intercept)`) |>
  mutate(death = clean_data$death)
```

PCA on all patients (death is only used to colour the points)
```{r}
pca_all <- x_data |>
  select(-death) |>
  prcomp(center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

scores_all <- pca_all$x |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(death = factor(x_data$death, levels = c(0, 1), 
                        labels = c("No death", "Death")))

pca_plot <- scores_all |>
  ggplot(aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, colour = death)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  stat_ellipse() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("No death" = "steelblue", "Death" = "tomato")) +
  labs(title = "PCA of all patients", colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)

pca_plot

ggsave(
  "../results/06_analysis_2/pca_scores_by_death.png",
  pca_plot,
  width = 20,
  height = 15,
  dpi = 300
)
```

Which PCs separate deceased from alive patients? (Wilcoxon test)
```{r}
map_dbl(paste0("PC", 1:10), ~ wilcox.test(scores_all[[.x]] ~ scores_all$death)$p.value) |>
  set_names(paste0("PC", 1:10)) |>
  signif(2)
```

PCA on deceased patients only and on alive patients only: 
loadings of PC1 and PC2.
Each arrow is one variable (only the 12 with the longest arrows are shown): 
the direction shows what it contributes to, the length shows how much.
Variables with arrows pointing the same way go up and down together.
```{r}
plots <- c(1, 0) |> 
  map(function(group) {
    x_data |> 
      filter(death == group) |> 
      select(-death) |> 
      select(where(~ sd(.x) > 0)) |> 
      prcomp(center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE) |> 
      pluck("rotation") |> 
      as_tibble(rownames = "variable") |> 
      slice_max(PC1^2 + PC2^2, n = 12) |> 
      ggplot(aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = variable)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey70") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey70") +
      geom_segment(
        aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1, yend = PC2),
        arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.15, "cm")),
        colour = "steelblue"
      ) +
      geom_text(size = 3, vjust = -0.5, check_overlap = TRUE) +
      labs(title = ifelse(group == 1, "Deceased", "Alive")) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
  })

combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 2) +
  plot_annotation(title = "PCA loadings: deceased vs alive patients")

combined_plot

ggsave(
  "../results/06_analysis_2/pca_loadings_deceased_vs_alive.png",
  combined_plot,
  width = 20,
  height = 15,
  dpi = 300
)
```

Top variables: standardized mean difference between deceased and alive
```{r}
smd_table <- x_data |>
  pivot_longer(-death, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") |>
  group_by(variable) |>
  summarise(smd = (mean(value[death == 1]) - mean(value[death == 0])) / sd(value)) |>
  arrange(desc(abs(smd)))

smd_plot <- smd_table |>
  slice_head(n = 15) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = smd, y = reorder(variable, abs(smd)), fill = smd > 0)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "tomato", "FALSE" = "steelblue")
                    , guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "Top 15 variables: deceased - alive (SMD)", 
       x = "SMD",
       y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)

smd_plot

ggsave(
  "../results/06_analysis_2/smd_top_variables.png",
  smd_plot,
  width = 20,
  height = 15,
  dpi = 300
)
```

Classification: stratified train / test split (70 / 30)
```{r}
set.seed(2026)

train_idx <- x_data |>
  mutate(row = row_number()) |>
  group_by(death) |>
  slice_sample(prop = 0.7) |>
  pull(row)

train_data <- x_data[train_idx, ]
test_data <- x_data[-train_idx, ]
```

Logistic regression on the first 10 PCs (PCA fitted on the training set only) and on all the variables
```{r}
pca_train <- train_data |> select(-death) |> 
  prcomp(center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

train_pcs <- as_tibble(pca_train$x[, 1:10]) |> 
  mutate(death = train_data$death)

test_pcs <- as_tibble(predict(pca_train, select(test_data, -death))[, 1:10])

fit_pca <- glm(death ~ ., data = train_pcs, family = binomial)
fit_full <- glm(death ~ ., data = train_data, family = binomial)

pred_pca <- predict(fit_pca, newdata = test_pcs, type = "response")
pred_full <- predict(fit_full, newdata = test_data, type = "response")
```

AUC and confusion matrix on the test set.
The death rate is ~16%, so the threshold is 
the training death rate instead of 0.5.
```{r}
get_auc <- function(pred, truth) {
  n1 <- sum(truth == 1)
  (sum(rank(pred)[truth == 1]) - n1 * (n1 + 1) / 2) / (n1 * sum(truth == 0))
}

threshold <- mean(train_data$death)

get_auc(pred_pca, test_data$death)
get_auc(pred_full, test_data$death)

table(predicted = pred_pca >= threshold, observed = test_data$death)
table(predicted = pred_full >= threshold, observed = test_data$death)
```

Variables with the strongest effect in the full model 
(standardized coefficients would be needed to compare them directly, 
so we look at the z value)
```{r}
summary(fit_full)$coefficients |>
  as_tibble(rownames = "variable") |>
  filter(variable != "(Intercept)") |>
  arrange(desc(abs(`z value`))) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)
```
